engineering_observations.interpretation: Observability only; no count authorized or terminated work.

recommendation: Retain the executable sentinel and receipt contract as a local checked-object completeness asset. Require sentinel PASS alongside checker acceptance when a workflow must prove that the checked artifact is exactly the requested theorem set and closure. No external action is authorized by this result alone.
claim_limit: One exact module, producer, format, two adapters and three faults; no general checker-correctness, exporter-completeness or semantic-authority claim.
